text:
Maya Patel: quick sync — we're starting bring-up for q6b-int4 this week. need to bootstrap labeler pool and a small calibration set. thinking fuzzyindex approach to collapse near-duplicates so labelers see unique prompts. thoughts?

Liam O'Connor: +1. what's target labeler pool size and calibration coverage?

Maya Patel: target 40 active labelers, 2k items sampling from prod-like bank, plus 250 calibration checks per labeler

Noor Ahmed: will 2k be representative? want stratified by length + intent. also we need to preserve rare intents (<=1% freq) — don't oversquash.

Ben Chu: agree. fuzzyindex params: sim_metric=cosine on embeddings, threshold=0.78 for cluster, but need experiments. we can produce clustered reps and then apply reservoir sampling inside each cluster.

Maya Patel: exact plan: generate embeddings using small embedder (embed-xsmall) -> build faiss index -> cluster -> sample. Labelers will get cluster representatives and a "nearby" negative sample to check micro-variations.

Samira K: what's label schema? binary good/bad? or multi-tag?

Maya Patel: multi-tag: correctness / hallucination / offensive / irrelevant. short doc for labeler UI will be ready.

Liam O'Connor: can we add automated pre-label with model A -> feed to labelers for verification? speeds up.

Noor Ahmed: yes but flag model-labeled as 'auto' for QC. track human override rate.

Ben Chu: metric proposals: inter-annotator agreement (Fleiss kappa), override rate, per-intent recall drop when moving from fp32 to int4. add embedding-cluster purity metric.

Maya Patel: timeline: today - produce clusters + sample CSV. Thu - labeler on-boarding + calibration run. Fri - aggregate metrics + spot re-sampling for low-agreement clusters.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: sample-generator v2 -> faiss-indexer at 2024-11-15T10:00Z

Samira K: labeling SLOs? how many labels per hour? expected throughput?

Maya Patel: assume 15 items/hr for multi-tag. calibration run should be ~20 labels per person.

Liam O'Connor: need to avoid bias from top-heavy clusters. propose cap samples per cluster to 5, with reservoir sampling by cluster size.

Noor Ahmed: also add synthetic paraphrase augmentation for low-frequency intents, mark them so we can measure synthetic vs real disagreement.

Ben Chu: code snippet for sampling we discussed:
```
# pseudo
emb = embed(batch_texts)
idx = faiss.search(emb, k=100)
clusters = graph_clust(idx, sim_threshold=0.78)
for c in clusters:
  reps = reservoir_sample(c, cap=5)
```

Maya Patel: nice. action items:
- Ben: produce clustered sample CSV + cluster metadata (size, purity) — due EOD today
- Liam: prepare labeler roster + onboarding doc — due Wed EOD
- Noor: draft calibration rubric + synthetic augmentation plan — due Thu morning
- Samira: set up labeler dashboard with override kpi — due Fri

Liam O'Connor: tagging @security for PII check? we might need deid flow.

Maya Patel: yes, @security please confirm before labeling.

Ben Chu: I'll add "sensitive" flag in CSV and drop items if flagged by deid pipeline.

Noor Ahmed: cool. quick Q — what's acceptance criteria to call bring-up "no-regression"?

Maya Patel: no more than 1.5% drop in intent recall vs baseline + kappa >= 0.6 across calibration set. override rate <10%.

Samira K: noted. anything else?

Liam O'Connor: can we run small canary on 2 models (fp32 and int4) and include pairwise blind checks?

Maya Patel: yes, pairwise blind A/B for 500 items. labelers blind order. add to schedule Fri afternoon.

Noor Ahmed: thanks all. I'll start prepping the sampling stratification.

Maya Patel: thanks team :thumbsup:
